// diagnostic E0781

Jet.GetRouteReachesMutation

{verb} route `{path}` reaches `{effect_name}` (`{access}`), which modifies kept state

What

{verb} route `{path}` reaches `{effect_name}` (`{access}`), which modifies kept state

Why

HTTP GET and HEAD requests must be safe and read-only so proxies, browsers, and retries can repeat them without modifying kept state

Fix

Move this mutation to a `POST`, `PUT`, `PATCH`, or `DELETE` route, or keep the {verb} handler read-only

Worked example
